## Flamengo boosted as Guillermo Varela returns for Fluminense derby

Guillermo Varela has rejoined Flamengo training and could start the Brasileirão derby with Fluminense at the Maracanã on Sunday at 17:30 Brasília time. According to Coluna Do Fla, the Uruguayan right-back is back with Leonardo Jardim’s group for the 30th round. [...] Flamengo have four confirmed absences. Jorginho is suspended after his red card against Santos, and will also miss the first leg of the Libertadores semi-final against Estudiantes (ARG) on 15 October. Ayrton Lucas is recovering from a grade 2 injury to the back of his right thigh.
